notes: Also: POST /api/auth/logout (204) signs this phone out; PUT /api/me/password {username, password, current_password?} (204; current_password is needed once there is a password; errors bad_request, password_wrong, username_taken); POST /api/me/delete (204) removes the account and signs out all its phones, 409 last_admin for the only admin. A revoked phone gets 401 signed_out everywhere.
